interface.longDescription:
This plugin helps your website get found in search engines and in AI answers, by chat.

What you can do:
- Check any page: paste its HTML or text to get scores for SEO, content, conversion, accessibility and technical basics, with a prioritized list of fixes.
- Find keywords: seed topics, long-tail phrases, questions, search intent, clusters and the page that should target each.
- Optimize pages: title tags and meta descriptions with character counts, headings, URL slugs, internal links and image alt text.
- Rank locally: business profile content, location pages, consistent name, address and phone, reviews and LocalBusiness schema.
- Fix technical SEO: crawling and indexing, robots.txt, XML sitemaps, canonicals, redirects, speed and Core Web Vitals.
- Plan and write content: topic clusters, editorial calendars, content briefs and SEO articles.
- Add structured data: JSON-LD for organizations, local businesses, products, articles, FAQs and more.
- Show up in AI answers: entity clarity, answer-ready content, citations and how to measure AI visibility.
- Outrank competitors: content and keyword gaps, link-worthy assets and safe link building.

Who it is for: business owners, marketers, bloggers, agencies and developers who want more search traffic.

How the tools work: the page checker analyzes only the HTML or text you share in the conversation. It never opens web addresses, and the pages you send are not stored. When you need live data this chat cannot provide, such as search volumes, rankings, backlinks or a crawl of your whole site, it can share a link that opens the matching live report on a partner SEO platform; the link includes the plugin creator's affiliate code. It is an independent plugin by AI Research Plus.

Limitations: it does not see live search data, your analytics or your site's dashboard, and it never invents search volumes, rankings or traffic. Rankings depend on search engines and are never guaranteed.

Replies that share the report link end with a one-line sponsor disclosure.

defaultPrompt: Help my site show up in AI answers

positive.description: SEO check of a product page
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the page checker with the HTML, reports the scores and flags the 5-character title, the missing meta description and viewport tag, and the missing canonical, Open Graph and language tags, then suggests a new title and meta description with their character counts and the other fixes in severity order.

positive.prompt: Check my title and meta description: <title>Best Running Shoes</title><meta name='description' content='Shoes.'>
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the page checker with the HTML, reports the 18-character title and the 6-character meta description as too short and the missing H1 heading, then proposes a title of 60 characters or fewer and a meta description of 155 or fewer with the counts stated.

positive.description: Keyword audit of a blog post
positive.prompt: Audit this blog post for the keyword trail running shoes: Running shoes. We sell shoes for every runner.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the page checker with the text, target keyword "trail running shoes" and page type blog, reports that the keyword never appears in the text or the main heading and that the copy is thin for a blog post, then suggests a heading, an opening and an outline that use the keyword naturally.

positive.prompt:
Why isn't this page on Google?

Prices
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the page checker with the HTML, reports that a robots meta tag tells search engines not to index the page (noindex), plus the missing title tag, meta description and viewport tag, then explains how to remove noindex and suggests the other fixes in severity order.

positive.prompt:
Check the headings and images on this page for SEO:

Menu

Order
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the page checker with the HTML, reports that the page has no H1 heading or title tag and that its 1 image has no alt text, plus the missing meta description and viewport tag, then suggests an H1, descriptive alt text and the other fixes in severity order.

negative.prompt: Write five blog post title ideas about home gardening.
Explain what a canonical tag is.
What is the capital of Italy?
